title: Approvals API hooks + types
definitionOfDone: useApprovals() list pending approvals with polling
useRejectJob() mutation (requires reason) with cache invalidation
useApproveStep() mutation for workflow step approvals

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useApprovals.ts: useApprovals() fetching GET /api/v1/approvals with 10s refetchInterval (high-priority data). useApprovalHistory(filters) fetching GET /api/v1/approvals/history with pagination and filters. useApproveJob() mutation (POST /api/v1/approvals/:id/approve with optional comment body). useRejectJob() mutation (POST /api/v1/approvals/:id/reject with required reason body). useApproveStep() mutation for workflow step approvals (POST /api/v1/approvals/:id/approve-step). All mutations invalidate ['approvals'] and ['approvals', 'nav'] (the nav badge count). WebSocket events for approval.* invalidate approvals cache.
implementationPlan.note: Added: useApprovalHistory() with pagination/sort filters, useApproveJob() (with alias useApproveApproval for compat), useRejectJob() with required reason field (aliased as useRejectApproval), useApproveStep() for workflow step approvals. All mutations invalidate both ['approvals'] and ['approvals','nav'] for badge count. useApprovals() already had 10s refetchInterval.
tsc --noEmit passes. Initial run had a transient error due to linter modifying ApprovalDetailModal.tsx concurrently; re-run was clean.
